Smith.ai isn’t just a receptionist. It’s a fully staffed front office — AI and live agents working together to handle every call, end to end. Our AI is deeply context-aware, connected to your key systems, and seamlessly integrated with our Live Agent Network.
Intake agent: Complex, sensitive, and conditional intake by your AI receptionist. The right questions get asked, the right details get captured, and the right outcome happens, every time.

Qualification agent: Custom qualification workflows for different practice areas, service types, and lead sources. Only qualified leads reach your team. Smart FAQ handling steers callers toward action, not just yes/no answers.
Data lookup agent: Connects to your systems in real time for dynamic pricing, ticket status, order lookups, and more. Callers get accurate answers from your AI receptionist without waiting.
Call routing agent: Intelligent conditional routing and transfers based on your business logic. Every caller reaches the right person, every time.

Automations agent: Triggers workflows with your business software the moment a call ends. Your AI receptionist sends data into your CRM, calendar, and ticketing systems without manual entry. And every call is recorded, transcribed, and instantly summarized.
Live Agent Network: 500+ North American agents available 24/7 for conversations that need a human touch. No call ever hits a dead end, and your team doesn’t get interrupted.

Frequently asked questions
What is Smith.ai?

Smith.ai is a 24/7 virtual receptionist and AI receptionist service for law firms and small businesses. Founded in 2015, Smith.ai combines AI agents and 500+ trained North America–based live receptionists to answer calls, qualify leads, book appointments, and run intake — so no call falls through the cracks.
Is Smith.ai an AI bot or a live receptionist service?

Both, working as one system. Smith.ai’s AI Receptionist handles routine intake, qualification, scheduling, and CRM updates automatically. When a call needs a human touch, 500+ trained North America–based live agents are available 24/7. AI and humans work together — not as separate products.
What types of businesses use Smith.ai?

Smith.ai serves 5,000+ businesses. Roughly 80% are law firms; the rest are home services contractors (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing), healthcare and dental practices, IT and MSPs, and other small businesses that need reliable 24/7 call coverage.
Does Smith.ai integrate with the tools I already use?

Yes. Smith.ai integrates with 7,000+ business tools, including Clio, Filevine, Lawmatics, MyCase, PracticePanther, HubSpot, Salesforce, ServiceTitan, and most major CRMs and practice management platforms. Calls automatically trigger CRM updates, calendar bookings, and SMS or email follow-up.
How quickly can I get started with Smith.ai?

Setup takes minutes. Live receptionists go live on Day 1 to protect your pipeline, while your AI Receptionist is trained and refined in parallel over the first few days. You’re never exposed to an AI ramp period.
Is Smith.ai available 24/7?
Yes — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. Both AI and live agents are available around the clock, including weekends and holidays. There are no after-hours surcharges and no voicemail.
